title: 時間よ止まれ
scope: Original short chord-switching drills for the requested song. No copied full score, lyric, melody or audio. Uniform four-beat timing is a learning scaffold, not the original phrasing.

references.use: Link to the publisher's beginner chart. The app drill uses common open shapes C, Em, G7, Am and Dm, without the full chart or lyrics.
Creator's own beginner lesson introduction; link to the associated lesson video.

key: Practice with no capo in C, lower than the original recording. Do not play along with the recording using the app's no-capo pitch targets.
guide: One synthesized chord strum at the beginning of each four-beat block; no recording or sampled instrument.
